text:
ellen-sales: Kicking off perf run for SolaraHealth. They want 1k sustained qps with occasional 5k microbursts, P95 <200ms for ~512-token responses. Need runbook + rough cost estimate by EOD. Can we scope?

devon-ps: got it. Clarify: hosted API path for MVP, but enterprise wants dedicated fallback for SLA. We'll test hosted footprint and a dedicated config.

mike-eng: For 512 tokens hitting standard LLM, we'll need batching + prefix KV caching to hit p95 200ms. Initial guess: 3 dedicated GPU workers (A10g or A100s equiv) with optimized kernels for low-latency. For hosted baseline, simulate 8 workers to model contended env.

zoe-sre: FYI Solara flagged cross-region failover and KMS. We'll run multi-az ramp during tests. Also need to validate egress costs in the estimate.

ellen-sales: Also they're strict on encryption in transit + at-rest; asked about HSM for keys in security questionnaire. harper-legal, any blockers?

harper-legal: HIPAA present in the questionnaire. We need confirmation on BAAs and KMS/HSM capabilities. Can provide standard certs but BAAs route needs sales/legal sign-off. Not blocking the run but call out in deck.

mike-eng: I'll draft load plan. Quick notes: request token distribution avg=400, sd=50; 70% plain generation, 30% chat-like with short context reuse. Use Poisson arrival with 1k mean plus 5k spike window (60s). Target profile: sustained 1k qps for 30m, bursts to 5k for 2m. Collect metrics: p50,p95,p99 latency, CPU/GPU util, kv-cache hit rate, batching efficiency.

perf-bot: Generated preliminary plan -> attach below

perf-bot: ```
# loadconfig
clients: 200
arrival_model: poisson
sustained_qps: 1000
burst_qps: 5000
burst_window_s: 120
payload: {tokens_mean:400,tokens_max:512}
metrics: [p50,p95,p99,throughput,err_rate,gpu_util]
routes: [hosted, dedicated-fallback]
failover: warm-fallback after 15s sustained error-rate>1% 
```

devon-ps: Nice. For pricing, Solara asked for per-1000-token estimate for hosted + committed tier for dedicated. Mike, can you give ballpark?

mike-eng: Ballpark (very rough): hosted = $0.035 per 1k input+output tokens at this SL, dedicated amortized ~ $0.018 per 1k tokens assuming 3-node reserved monthly and good batching. Add caching could drop unit to ~$0.012 for steady-state. Callouts: burst pricing and multi-region egress extra.

zoe-sre: Operational notes: enable prefix KV cache for 90% repeated prompts; set max-batch-latency=6ms to keep P95 <200ms. Also thread-local cache warms first 5k requests. We'll surface cold-start numbers separately.

ellen-sales: Good. Can someone produce a 1-slide summary and an ops runbook snippet I can send to Solara? They want a quick read before our 3pm sync.

mike-eng: I'll drop a short runbook block.

mike-eng: ```
# ops runbook snippet
pre-checks: ensure KMS keys provisioned, nodes in same region
ramp: 0->100qps in 2m, 100->1k in 10m, hold 30m
burst test: inject to 5k for 120s at minute 45
observability: enable token perf logging, per-route traces
fallback: on sustained errors >1% for 15s route to dedicated, notify #eng-oncall
post-run: collect p95, kv-hit, batch-size histograms, GPU mem pressure
```

harper-legal: I'll prepare a short note on BAA steps and KMS options to append.

devon-ps: I'll compile the slide with cost table + risk rows (HIPAA/KMS, multi-region latency, cold-start). Will send draft in channel in 45m.

ellen-sales: Thanks team. If SRE/eng can flag anything that would make the estimate conservative, call it out. Want minimal surprises in the exec summary.

zoe-sre: One conservative callout: network tail when crossing AZs can add ~30-60ms; keep multi-az failover timings tuned. Also ensure TLS session reuse on edge.

mike-eng: Noted. I'll add a column for expected tail delta in the draft.

ellen-sales: Perfect. tagging @perf-bot to run the sim overnight and we can share results tomorrow AM. :thumbsup: 

perf-bot: Run scheduled: job_id=ph-solara-2023-10-21-01. Will post summarized metrics on completion.

ellen-sales: Closing thread — will post Solara response once I have it. Thanks!
